summary: Official municipal evidence establishes a Cadastro Imobiliário and geoprocessing responsibility, and the city links a current Prodata SIG portal. The public SIG entrypoint is login-gated; no safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was qualified. No sample GeoJSON is retained.
custodian: Prefeitura Municipal de Águas Lindas de Goiás is the local municipal fiscal-cadastre custodian; Prodata SIG is the linked service portal. IBGE is only a general national mapping source here, not a local cadastral custodian.
requests: All discovery queries and executed requests, including outcomes and URLs, are recorded in the city record. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe-field request, or TLS exception was used.
